# Krishnanand Anil - Senior Data Engineer & Cloud Architect

> Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience specializing in real-time streaming architectures, AWS cloud platforms, Apache Kafka CDC pipelines, and enterprise data warehouses. Expert in processing 50M+ events daily, reducing pipeline latency by 96%, and architecting sub-second analytical serving systems.

Krishnanand Anil is a Bengaluru-based Senior Data Engineer and Cloud Architect with a proven track record of reducing data pipeline runtimes from 4 hours to 10 minutes (96% drop), scaling financial ingestion to 5M+ daily records with 99.9% uptime, and improving cloud cost efficiency by 60%. Core expertise spans Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, AWS (Lambda, Glue, EMR, Redshift, S3), Delta Lake/Iceberg medallion lakehouses, Python, and Snowflake.

## Featured Engineering Projects

- [Real-Time CDC Pipeline](https://krishnanandanil.com/projects/realtime-cdc-pipeline): Production CDC streaming pipeline using Kafka, Debezium, and custom Python consumers processing 50M+ events daily (<50ms latency)
- [Enterprise Data Warehouse](https://krishnanandanil.com/projects/enterprise-data-warehouse): Unified OLAP matrix with automated ETL/ELT workflows cutting query times to 0.24s
- [Hydrological Data Lakehouse](https://krishnanandanil.com/projects/medallion-data-lake): Medallion architecture (Bronze -> Silver -> Gold) processing 5TB+ monthly with ACID compliance
- [AI-Ready Analytics Platform](https://krishnanandanil.com/projects/ai-analytics-platform): GenAI-powered analytics foundation with vector embeddings and semantic search
